hooks.A: 误认反转。可换说法：Most people think this is real [compareTo], but it isn't. / This looks like [compareTo], but [benefit]. / It looks like [compareTo], but it is made for [benefit].
hooks.B: 反问对比。可换说法：Why use [compareTo] if this [benefit]? / Why are more buyers choosing this instead of [compareTo]? / Why do more projects choose this over [compareTo]?
hooks.C: 早知道。可换说法：If I knew this [product type] earlier, I would skip [compareTo]. / If I had known about this [product type] earlier, I would have skipped more troublesome materials.
hooks.D: 条件引导。可换说法：If you want [result], watch this. / If you like [style], check this first. / If you need [result], this is worth seeing.
hooks.E: 效果断言。可换说法：[texture] makes the [wall/floor] look instantly more expensive. / This finish can change the whole feeling of a space. / [texture] can change the whole mood of a room.
hooks.F: 好奇/不可能。可换说法：Have you ever seen a [look] that can [unexpected benefit]? / Traditional [compareTo] cannot do this. / [unexpected benefit], but it still looks like [look].（不能写成 real stone / glass mirror / solid wood that…，产品不是传统材料）
hooks.G: 直接给结果。可换说法：You can get [effect] without [hassle]. / [effect], but [safer/lighter/easier]. / This is how you get [effect] more easily.
